result.title: MeterRouter: Budget-Aware Dynamic Routing for Multi-Agent Systems
result.summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) outperform single-agent systems, but inter-agent communication incurs substantial token overhead. While assigning a large LLM to every agent is common, it results in inefficient resource utilization, leaving the system far from the Pareto frontier. The cost of answering a query is set jointly by how many agents are recruited, the role and LLM assigned to each, and communication topology among them. Most existing routers treat cost only implicitly rather than as an explicit optimization constraint. A fixed accuracy-cost preference also cannot express how much a caller is willing to pay for a particular query. We introduce MeterRouter, a budget-aware dynamic router that incrementally synthesizes a collaboration graph by selecting each agent's role, LLM, incoming connections, and termination conditioned on the query and a per-query monetary budget. We initialize the router by imitating successful execution graphs, then jointly refine its decisions with a variant of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) whose reward favors correct answers and penalizes spending and budget overruns. Across five benchmarks and a three-tier LLM pool, MeterRouter is (1) accurate, achieving performance comparable to the strongest MAS; (2) economical, reaching that accuracy at 82% lower cost than the strongest MAS router and extending the accuracy-cost frontier beyond the ceiling of single-agent systems; and (3) controllable, adapting its spending to the specified budget while rarely exceeding it.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 MeterRouter，把多智能体协作图的构建（角色、所配 LLM、连边与终止）建立在「每查询货币预算」条件下，先用成功执行图做模仿初始化，再用带花费与超支惩罚的 GRPO 变体联合微调路由决策。在五个基准与三层模型池上取得与最强 MAS 相当的准确率，同时成本显著更低并能随预算调节支出。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预算条件化的增量决策 + 对花费与提前终止施加惩罚」的奖励设计，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/STOP 的计算分配与停止决策提供可核查的训练与评价线索，但研究对象是多智能体路由而非视觉推理状态，迁移需自行判断。
